presets.title: خطوط قلم نظيفة
presets.description: حدود واضحة لأي موضوع، وملامح مقروءة حين يوجد وجه، دون ظلال؛ بداية مناسبة لمسار القلم.
presets.prompt: Redraw the main reference as a clean black pen line drawing on pure white paper. Draw only the subject that is in the reference, with confident continuous contours and a recognizable silhouette. Keep the features it really has clearly readable; when it shows a face, that means the eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth. Simplify fine detail such as hair, fur or fabric into a few purposeful lines and major folds. Keep the original proportions and do not add people, faces or objects that are not in the reference. Leave interiors white, without shading, hatching, gray fills or surface texture.

presets.title: بورتريه مختصر
presets.description: اقتصاد في الخطوط مع إعطاء الأولوية لملامح الوجه.
presets.prompt: Create an elegant minimalist contour portrait from the main reference. Select only the most informative contours that communicate likeness: eyes, eyebrows, nose profile, lips, jaw and major hair shapes. Use sparse long flowing black lines on white. Omit minor wrinkles, pores, fabric texture and background. Keep both eyes legible when visible. Avoid decorative extra strokes. Do not force the entire drawing into one continuous line.

presets.title: رصاص واقعي
presets.description: ملمس غرافيت وتظليل مقصود؛ أغنى من رسم المسارات المختصر.
presets.prompt: Translate the main reference into a refined hand-drawn graphite portrait on white drawing paper. Build form with delicate directional pencil strokes, controlled crosshatching and a balanced range of values. Keep the eyes crisp and expressive, skin shading subtle, and edges varied. Preserve anatomical proportions. The result should visibly read as graphite on paper rather than a desaturated photograph.

presets.title: رصاص خفيف بلا تهشير
presets.description: خطوط رصاص أساسية مع تقليل التظليل والملمس.
presets.prompt: Draw the main reference as a light graphite outline sketch on clean white paper. Keep the same subject, shapes and proportions, and draw only what the reference contains. A few long expressive contours mark its most important structural edges; when it shows a face, keep the facial features precise. Leave large surfaces white. Avoid crosshatching, tonal shading, filled black masses and scratchy texture.

presets.title: صفحة تلوين
presets.description: حدود سوداء ومساحات بيضاء واضحة قابلة للتلوين.
presets.prompt: Convert the main reference into a polished coloring-book illustration. Use clean readable black outlines of consistent visual weight and spacious white unfilled areas. Simplify small details while preserving the subject's defining shapes. Make eyes and hands anatomically coherent. No gradients, grayscale, shading, hatching, text or decorative border.

presets.title: رسم غرض أو منتج
presets.description: شكل الغرض وحوافه البنيوية، دون ملمس أو انعكاسات مشتتة.
presets.prompt: Redraw the main reference object as a precise technical-looking pen illustration on white. Retain its silhouette, proportions, visible openings, seams and essential structural edges. Suppress surface texture, specular reflections, cast shadows and background clutter. Use clear separated black contour lines. Do not invent hidden geometry, dimensions or labels.

presets.title: حيوان بخطوط معبّرة
presets.description: العينان والأنف والهيئة مع اختصار الفرو إلى مجموعات.
presets.prompt: Create a clean expressive pen portrait of the animal in the main reference. Preserve its species, head angle, eye placement, nose, ears and distinctive silhouette. Group fur or feathers into a small number of purposeful contour tufts instead of tracing every strand. Black lines on white, no tonal fill or background, with clear separation between important features.

presets.title: رسم معماري خطي
presets.description: المبنى والمنظور والحواف الرئيسية دون نسيج الجدران.
presets.prompt: Turn the main reference building or interior into an elegant architectural line illustration. Preserve the visible perspective, dominant edges, rooflines, doors and windows. Simplify repeated minor details while retaining the design's character. Use crisp black lines on white with restrained line hierarchy. Omit material texture, reflections, foliage texture and tonal shading. Do not add measurements or unseen structures.

presets.title: ألوان مائية شفافة
presets.description: غسلات لونية وحواف ناعمة وملمس ورق مائي.
presets.prompt: Reinterpret the main reference as a traditional watercolor painting on textured cold-pressed white paper. Use luminous transparent pigment washes, selective soft bleeding edges, restrained granulation and a few confident brush accents. Retain clear focal features and believable anatomy. Keep skin tones natural and shadows chromatically subtle. Make the painting visibly handmade rather than photorealistic.

presets.title: كاريكاتير تحريري
presets.description: مبالغة لطيفة مدروسة مع محاولة إبقاء الشخصية معروفة.
presets.prompt: Create a professional editorial caricature of the person in the main reference. Identify and gently exaggerate the distinctive facial relationships while keeping the person recognizable. Use an expressive slightly enlarged head, confident hand-drawn contours, economical detail and a clean white background. Keep the expression friendly and anatomy coherent. Avoid generic cartoon facial features.

presets.title: كرتون مسطح
presets.description: ألوان محدودة وحدود واضحة وتبسيط للكتل.
presets.prompt: Transform the main reference into a sophisticated flat 2D cartoon illustration. Use a limited harmonious color palette, clean bold contour lines and simple cel-shaded forms. Preserve the subject's distinctive silhouette and recognizable facial relationships. Simplify textures into designed shapes. White background, no photographic skin texture or 3D-rendered appearance.

presets.title: حبر وغسلات
presets.description: خطوط حبر حرة مع درجات رمادية مقتصدة.
presets.prompt: Interpret the main reference as an expressive ink-and-wash illustration. Combine confident black contour strokes with a few translucent gray washes that describe the major planes. Keep focal features sharply readable and let secondary edges dissolve into white paper. Use intentional visual hierarchy rather than dense scratchy detail.

presets.title: غواش توضيحي
presets.description: مساحات لونية معتمة ولمسات فرشاة ظاهرة.
presets.prompt: Repaint the main reference as a contemporary gouache illustration on matte paper. Use opaque layered color shapes, visible controlled brushwork, simplified lighting planes and a harmonious restrained palette. Preserve the subject's proportions and identifying features. Avoid glossy photographic rendering and overly airbrushed transitions.

presets.title: خلفية استوديو بيضاء
presets.description: إعادة توليد الخلفية بيضاء؛ لا ينتج قناع شفافية.
presets.prompt: Replace only the background of the main reference with a clean white studio backdrop. Preserve the main subject, its clothing, visible accessories, pose and natural appearance as closely as possible. Use a subtle believable contact shadow if the object touches a surface. Do not add objects or text. Produce a normal image with a white background, not a transparency mask.

presets.title: إضاءة استوديو ناعمة
presets.description: ضوء ناعم وملامح مقروءة دون تغيير مقصود للهوية.
presets.prompt: Relight the main reference with a large soft studio key light from camera-left and gentle fill from camera-right. Preserve the subject, pose, clothing and setting. Keep skin texture believable, highlights controlled and shadow detail readable. Aim for natural professional portrait lighting without plastic skin or an extreme cinematic color grade.

presets.title: تنظيف المشهد
presets.description: استبدل [the unwanted items] في نص الوصف بما تريد إزالته، بالإنجليزية.
presets.prompt: Clean up the main reference by removing [the unwanted items] while preserving the principal subject and composition. Reconstruct a simple coherent background with consistent perspective and lighting. Remove only the items named above. Do not remove or alter the person's body, clothes or accessories unless explicitly requested.

presets.title: صورة منتج احترافية
presets.description: إضاءة وخلفية للمنتج مع محاولة الحفاظ على تصميمه.
presets.prompt: Create a polished studio product photograph based on the object in the main reference. Preserve its shape, material, color and visible design details. Place it against a restrained seamless background with soft controlled reflections and a subtle contact shadow. Keep the whole product visible. Do not invent branding, labels, extra parts or text.

presets.title: تعليمات حرة
presets.description: اكتب التغيير المطلوب بوضوح، وحدد ما تريد الحفاظ عليه.

presets.title: نقل أسلوب مرجعي
presets.description: استعر طريقة الرسم والألوان فقط، مع إبقاء محتوى الصورة الرئيسية وبنيتها كما هي.
presets.prompt: Use image 1 as the exclusive source of all image content: subject category and identity, number of subjects and objects, silhouette, parts, geometry, pose, composition and background. Keep the same subject category and do not invent, substitute, attach or duplicate any content. References assigned the style role may affect rendering only: linework, brushwork, texture, palette and shading. They must have zero influence on subject matter, identity, silhouette, geometry, objects, people, faces, clothing, scene or background. Do not copy, depict or imply any content found only in a style reference. If image 1 contains no person or face, the result must contain no person, face, body or clothing. Use every other reference only for its assigned role.

presets.title: دمج غرض مرجعي
presets.description: ادمج المرجع المعيّن كغرض داخل المشهد؛ استبدل [where and how large] بموضعه وحجمه.
presets.prompt: Use image 1 as the main scene. Integrate each reference assigned the object/product role into that scene, placed [where and how large], using its appearance and geometry. Apply every other reference only according to its assigned role; never treat a style, identity or composition reference as the object. Match the object's scale, perspective and illumination to the scene. Preserve the main subject's identity and avoid duplicating the object.

presets.title: شخصية بمرجع هوية
presets.description: مرجع إضافي لملامح الشخص؛ لا يضمن قفل الهوية.
presets.prompt: Use image 1 for the main composition and pose. Use image 2 as an additional identity reference of the same person, paying attention to facial proportions, eye shape, nose, mouth and hairline. Produce one coherent depiction of that person, without merging unrelated faces.

presets.title: بورتريه من الوصف
presets.description: شخصية جديدة بالكامل دون صورة. أضف في آخر الوصف ملامحها وتعبيرها.
presets.prompt: Create a refined graphite portrait of an adult character with an expressive face, a natural three-quarter head angle and relaxed shoulders. Use accurate anatomy, crisp eyes, subtle directional pencil shading and white drawing paper. Compose a balanced head-and-shoulders portrait with generous breathing room. The image contains no text, captions, lettering or signature.

presets.title: مشهد توضيحي
presets.description: مشهد جديد. استبدل [subject, place and action] بموضوعك، وأضف الإضاءة إن شئت.
presets.prompt: Create a coherent editorial illustration of [subject, place and action], with a clear focal subject, purposeful composition and a restrained harmonious palette. Establish foreground, middle ground and background with believable spatial relationships. Avoid accidental extra objects and unnecessary text.

presets.title: رسم جديد للقلم
presets.description: رسم خطي جديد للمراجعة قبل المسارات. استبدل [subject] بما تريد رسمه.
presets.prompt: Create a clean black pen outline illustration of [subject] on pure white paper, designed for economical physical pen drawing. Use long purposeful contours, readable shapes and spacious unfilled areas. Avoid shading, crosshatching, gradients, texture and tiny decorative marks. Maintain coherent anatomy and geometry. The image contains no text, captions, lettering or signature.

low: Keep only the most informative structural details; omit small textures and minor folds.
balanced: Use a balanced amount of detail, with a clear focal hierarchy and restrained secondary detail.
high: Retain rich meaningful detail while keeping forms legible and avoiding random micro-texture.

none: Leave large surfaces unshaded; no tonal fills, hatching or cast-shadow patterns.
light: Use only a few restrained light shadow accents to suggest major planes.
full: Describe volume with a controlled full tonal range and coherent directional shading.

grouped: Group hair, fur or feathers into a few designed shapes; do not trace every strand.
detailed: Describe selected individual hair or fur strands with deliberate direction and clear grouping.

white: Use a clean pure-white background without scenery or decorative elements.
keep: Retain the original background composition and its major elements as closely as possible.
simple: Reduce the background to a few quiet shapes that do not compete with the main subject.

soft: Use soft diffuse illumination with readable shadow detail and controlled highlights.
side: Use a coherent side light to reveal the main planes without losing focal features in darkness.
flat: Use even illumination to keep all important features clearly visible.

clean: Use confident clean extended contours with few disconnected fragments or repeated parallel edge strokes.
expressive: Use intentional expressive hand-drawn strokes with controlled variation and avoid random scratchy noise.

simple: Reduce clothing detail to its silhouette and a few structural folds; omit fabric texture and tiny creases.
detailed: Retain the clothing's meaningful construction details, major seams and directional folds.

mono: Use a strictly monochrome black-and-white visual treatment without colored accents.
muted: Use a restrained low-saturation harmonious palette with natural skin colors.
warm: Use a balanced warm palette without turning skin unnaturally orange or red.
cool: Use a balanced cool palette while retaining believable natural skin colors.

identity: Preserve only defining features actually visible in the main reference. Preserve facial identity only when a face is present there; never add a face or human traits to a non-human subject.
pose: Keep the main reference's pose, head angle, framing and spatial composition.
clothes: Retain only clothing or accessories visible in the main reference; do not introduce them when absent.

style: Use this reference only to change rendering (linework, brushwork, palette, shading and texture). Never transfer, add or infer any subject, person, face, body, clothing, object, silhouette, geometry or background from this reference; all image content must come from image 1 or another reference explicitly assigned that content role.
identity: Use this reference as an additional subject identity guide, not as a replacement composition.
object: Use this reference for the appearance and geometry of the object to integrate.
composition: Use this reference as guidance for scene layout and spatial composition.
